title: Playing time tracks recent exposure in fifteen men's and women's football leagues: the denominator gradient and what it does to per-minute injury rates
description: Replication record for a study of the denominator gradient: the slope of log recorded match minutes on recent match exposure, which measures how much of an exposure association a per-minute denominator divides out. The gradient is measured in fifteen European first tiers across both sexes - 658,286 appearances: 628,487 men's across eight leagues and 29,799 women's across seven, the women's panel deposited as a surrogate-keyed appearance table carrying performance records only and no health information. The record contains the manuscript and supplement, the full analysis pipeline, its test suite at complete statement and branch coverage, the hand-built audit evidence no script can regenerate, the deposited results tables behind every reported number - including the calibration sweep with its 1000-player-resample intervals - and the documentation needed to rerun everything from the committed inputs.
